<span class="origin-badge origin-badge--bareos">Bareos</span>

Close connection.

## Synopsis

```text
.quit
```

Words without brackets are required, `[ ]` marks optional parts, `a | b` alternatives, `...` a repeatable argument and `[,...]` a comma separated list.

## Description

Ends the console session: the Director closes the connection without sending text. It is the dot-command form of quit and exit meant for programs. Running jobs continue. Further words on the line are ignored.

In API mode 1 the Director sends the signals CMD\_BEGIN and CMD\_OK before closing, in mode 2 additionally an empty JSON-RPC result; no MAIN\_PROMPT follows in any mode. If the Command ACL does not allow .quit, the connection stays open.

## Examples

Close the connection:

```text
.quit
```
